_comment: The normative statement for each requirement in .abydos/backlog/spec. OpenSpec's validator demands SHALL or MUST in the first line of a requirement body; the backlog spec is deliberately present-tense prose. Rather than rewrite 6,300 lines and create a second copy that drifts, extract-from-backlog.py regenerates openspec/specs/ from the backlog spec and takes the normative line for each requirement from here. A requirement added to the backlog spec and not listed here is reported by name rather than silently skipped.

purposes.diagrams: Mermaid diagrams, drawn by the real Mermaid in a web view and then flattened into geometry, so that the same file is the same picture in the app's own pane, in Preview.app and in a browser. Covers what is drawn, what is written out, and what a build says when it has not got the layout a diagram asks for.
purposes.editor: The text editor: what the keys do, where the caret comes to rest, how a selection is drawn when the keyboard is elsewhere, and how find marks the page. Every offset the editor works in is logical, and reordering happens only when a line is drawn.
purposes.previews: Files whose rendered form is the point of them — Mermaid, Cadova models, go3mf recipes, pictures — shown beside or instead of their source, built only once somebody has looked, and never by writing into the project.
purposes.screenshots: Driving the app from the command line: taking pictures of it, typing into it, and asking it what it is showing. Covers what makes a run a driven one and what a driven run is forbidden to touch on the machine it runs on.
purposes.tool-images: Language servers and other tools that come from a container image rather than from the PATH: how an image is chosen, fetched, built here from a recipe Abydos ships, watched while it is slow, and cleaned up after a run that died.

statements.A start that cannot launch an agent says: A start that cannot launch an agent SHALL say where the work is.

statements.An item is picked up into a worktree of: An item SHALL be picked up into a worktree of its own.
statements.The spec says what the project does, and: The spec SHALL say what the project does, and an item SHALL change it by delta.
statements.Every item tracks what is done and what: Every item SHALL track what is done and what is missing.
statements.A project is set up for its assistants b: A project SHALL be set up for its assistants by one command.
statements.A devcontainer is asked for before it is: A devcontainer SHALL be asked for before it is started.

statements.An answer naming a container the project: An answer naming a container the project no longer offers SHALL become a question again.
statements.The titlebar says a container is in use,: The titlebar SHALL say that a container is in use, and SHALL NOT say which one.
statements.The pill's menu lists the containers and: The pill's menu SHALL list the containers and SHALL switch between them.
statements.Bringing a container up is visible where: Bringing a container up SHALL be visible where it is slow.
statements.A drawing is a picture everywhere, not o: A drawing SHALL be the same picture everywhere, not only in a browser.
statements.A diagram that asks for a layout this bu: A diagram that asks for a layout this build has not got SHALL say so.
statements.A pane with no diagram in it says why, a: A pane with no diagram in it SHALL say why, and the indicator SHALL stay clear of what it says.
statements.⌘/ comments out the lines a selection to: ⌘/ SHALL comment out the lines a selection touches.
statements.the comment goes at the indent the lines: The comment SHALL go at the indent the lines share.
statements.blank lines are neither commented nor co: Blank lines SHALL be neither commented nor counted.
statements.the selection still covers the same text: The selection SHALL still cover the same text afterwards.
statements.a language with no line comment says so: A language with no line comment SHALL say so rather than nothing.
statements.an embedded language gets its host's com: An embedded language SHALL get its host's comment, not its own.
statements.↑ on the first line and ↓ on the last go: ↑ on the first line and ↓ on the last SHALL go to the edge of the file.
statements.Shift takes the selection to the edge wi: Shift SHALL take the selection to the edge with it.
statements.⌃B and ⌃F move the caret a character, an: ⌃B and ⌃F SHALL move the caret a character, and so SHALL ← and →.
statements.⌃A and ⌃E go to the ends of the line, an: ⌃A and ⌃E SHALL go to the ends of the line, and so SHALL ⌥↑ and ⌥↓.
statements.⌃K deletes to the end of the line and le: ⌃K SHALL delete to the end of the line and SHALL leave the newline.
statements.⌃O opens a line under the caret and leav: ⌃O SHALL open a line under the caret and SHALL leave the caret alone.
statements.A selection is drawn gray while the keyb: A selection SHALL be drawn gray while the keyboard is somewhere else.
statements.A place the editor is sent to is on the: A place the editor is sent to SHALL be on the screen when it gets there.
statements.The current find match is the loudest th: The current find match SHALL be the loudest thing on the page.
statements.The find highlights are the scheme's col: The find highlights SHALL be the scheme's colours.
statements.A tool Xcode owns comes from Xcode, not: A tool Xcode owns SHALL come from Xcode, not from the PATH.
statements.One search finds every tool this program: One search SHALL find every tool this program runs.
statements.A language server is kept until the app: A language server SHALL be kept until the app goes, and no longer.
statements.One server per project per server, not p: There SHALL be one server per project per server, not one per language.
statements.What is running can be seen and stopped: What is running SHALL be visible, and SHALL be stoppable.
statements.A project chooses which server answers f: A project SHALL choose which server answers for a language.
statements.A chosen server that cannot be started s: A chosen server that cannot be started SHALL say so.
statements.Choosing where a server comes from takes: Choosing where a server comes from SHALL take effect now.
statements.The footer says which server is answerin: The footer SHALL say which server is answering, and from where.
statements.A server that started and is not answeri: A server that started and is not answering SHALL say so above the file.
statements.A server can change the code, and rename: A server SHALL be able to change the code, and rename SHALL be what it is asked for.
statements.A rename that cannot be offered is not o: A rename that cannot be offered SHALL NOT be offered.
statements.A rename says which kind of rename it is: A rename SHALL say which kind of rename it is.
statements.A workspace edit is worked out in full b: A workspace edit SHALL be worked out in full before anything is written.
statements.A workspace edit reaches open documents: A workspace edit SHALL reach open documents through the rope, and SHALL reach files that move.
statements.A whole rename is one undo: A whole rename SHALL be one undo.
statements.A server that declines after offering is: A server that declines after offering SHALL be named.
statements.Debugging Java does not depend on which: Debugging Java SHALL NOT depend on which server edits it.
statements.A project or a person can name the execu: A project or a person SHALL be able to name the executable for a server.
statements.A project can say what to tell a server: A project SHALL be able to say what to tell a server when it starts.
statements.A completion is inserted as text, and it: A completion SHALL be inserted as text, and its stops SHALL be stepped through.
statements.The Swift indexer builds outside the pro: The Swift indexer SHALL build outside the project, and SHALL stand outside it too.
statements.Keeping a server costs no other tool its: Keeping a server SHALL cost no other tool its turn.
statements.A file whose rendered form is the point: A file whose rendered form is the point of it SHALL open showing both.
statements.A preview nobody has looked at yet costs: A preview nobody has looked at yet SHALL cost nothing.
statements.A Cadova model is built and run to be se: A Cadova model SHALL be built and run in order to be seen.
statements.Rendering a recipe does not write into t: Rendering a recipe SHALL NOT write into the project.
statements.A model that would not render shows no m: A model that would not render SHALL show no model.
statements.A picture opens whole and can be looked: A picture SHALL open whole, and SHALL be able to be looked at closely.
statements.A project shows what it depends on, besi: A project SHALL show what it depends on, beside its own files.
statements.A dependency says which version it is an: A dependency SHALL say which version it is and where it came from.
statements.A kind of project this cannot read says: A kind of project this cannot read SHALL say so, on a row.
statements.A dependency says which subproject resol: A dependency SHALL say which subproject resolved it.
statements.A file with no place in the tree is reve: A file with no place in the tree SHALL be revealed in the section.
statements.A list that is read and incomplete says: A list that is read and incomplete SHALL say what is missing.
statements.A folder a build system marks is a proje: A folder a build system marks SHALL be a project of its own.
statements.A compiler's own sources have a row, onc: A compiler's own sources SHALL have a row, once somebody goes there.
statements.What a project can run is found rather t: What a project can run SHALL be found rather than configured.
statements.The list is refreshed by writes that cou: The list SHALL be refreshed by writes that could change it.
statements.A Swift package offers its executables a: A Swift package SHALL offer its executables and its tests.
statements.A manifest is read and not run: A manifest SHALL be read and SHALL NOT be run.
statements.A capture is a picture of the app, not o: A capture SHALL be a picture of the app, not of the machine it was taken on.
statements.A run given a launch verb is a driven ru: A run given a launch verb SHALL be a driven run, and nothing SHALL have to remember to say so.
statements.A driven run changes nothing that belong: A driven run SHALL change nothing that belongs to whoever is at the keyboard.
statements.A driven run opens what it was given, an: A driven run SHALL open what it was given, and SHALL type only into that.
statements.Search results can be marked done, sever: Search results SHALL be able to be marked done, several at a time.
statements.Marking done is never a deletion, and ⌘⌫: Marking done SHALL never be a deletion, and ⌘⌫ SHALL never be the key for it.
statements.A mark survives the search being run aga: A mark SHALL survive the search being run again.
statements.Marks are hidden on request, so the list: Marks SHALL be hidden on request, so that the list can also empty.
statements.⌘Z in the results list takes back the la: ⌘Z in the results list SHALL take back the last marking.
statements.The results list can be worked from the: The results list SHALL be able to be worked from the keyboard.
statements.Search results go wherever a usages list: Search results SHALL go wherever a usages list goes.
statements.The window goes on answering while a bro: The window SHALL go on answering while a broad search runs.
statements.A list that is not the whole answer says: A list that is not the whole answer SHALL say so.
statements.A tab comes back in the mode it was bein: A tab SHALL come back in the mode it was being shown in.
statements.A split comes back with its divider wher: A split SHALL come back with its divider where it was left.
statements.A session that says nothing about a mode: A session that says nothing about a mode SHALL get the file kind's default.
statements.A mode is ignored for a file that cannot: A mode SHALL be ignored for a file that cannot be shown in it.
statements.A driven run neither restores a session: A driven run SHALL neither restore a session nor write one.
statements.A pane does not inherit a tmux socket pa: A pane SHALL NOT inherit a tmux socket path that could not exist.
statements.A pane says how large one of its cells i: A pane SHALL say how large one of its cells is, and SHALL say so again when that changes.
statements.A picture placed where there is not room: A picture placed where there is not room for it SHALL make the room.
statements.A pane shows what a command printed even: A pane SHALL show what a command printed even if the command has already finished.
statements.A pane can be emulated by libghostty-vt: A pane SHALL be able to be emulated by libghostty-vt instead of by our own emulator.
statements.An engine says what it cannot do, and th: An engine SHALL say what it cannot do, and the missing parts SHALL refuse rather than guess.
statements.A picture drawn with unicode placeholder: A picture drawn with unicode placeholders SHALL be shown under either engine.
statements.A pane draws at the display's rate while: A pane SHALL draw at the display's rate while a program keeps up, and SHALL NOT replay a backlog.
statements.Either engine names the rows that change: Either engine SHALL name the rows that changed, and neither SHALL say "all of them" unless they did.
statements.How big a terminal is and how much histo: How big a terminal is and how much history it has SHALL be cheap questions, and asking them SHALL NOT copy the screen.
statements.A window follows its terminal out of the: A window SHALL follow its terminal out of the project, and nowhere else.
statements.A program started in a pane begins with: A program started in a pane SHALL begin with a signal state of its own.
statements.A pane's pseudo-terminal is not handed t: A pane's pseudo-terminal SHALL NOT be handed to the next program started.
statements.A tool can come from an image, and the p: A tool SHALL be able to come from an image, and the project's choice SHALL win.
statements.An image that is not here is fetched bef: An image that is not here SHALL be fetched before the tool is first used.
statements.A server in a container talks about file: A server in a container SHALL talk about files by their names on this machine.
statements.A published image is only offered once s: A published image SHALL only be offered once somebody has run it.
statements.Every language server this editor offers: Every language server this editor offers SHALL have an image this repository builds.
statements.A tool can be built here from a recipe A: A tool SHALL be able to be built here from a recipe Abydos ships.
statements.An edited recipe rebuilds and an unedite: An edited recipe SHALL rebuild, and an unedited one SHALL never rebuild.
statements.Nothing built here is ever fetched from: Nothing built here SHALL ever be fetched from a registry.
statements.A build that fails says which kind of fa: A build that fails SHALL say which kind of failure it was.
statements.A server may say it reads directories th: A server SHALL be allowed to say it reads directories the project does not contain, and that SHALL NOT be treated as a failure.
statements.An image that takes minutes is watched r: An image that takes minutes SHALL be watched rather than waited for.
statements.A project pinning a toolchain the image: A project pinning a toolchain the image has not got SHALL be told before anything starts.
statements.A recipe can be asked for that is not th: A recipe that is not the tool's own SHALL be able to be asked for.
statements.A container an earlier run left behind i: A container an earlier run left behind SHALL be removed by the next one, in whichever runtime holds it.
statements.Usages arrive in the bottom panel, besid: Usages SHALL arrive in the bottom panel, beside search.
statements.A usages list is the same checklist sear: A usages list SHALL be the same checklist search is.
statements.↓ through a usages list shows each one a: ↓ through a usages list SHALL show each one, and SHALL keep the keyboard.
statements.A usages list can be expanded into a win: A usages list SHALL be able to be expanded into a window, and that SHALL be remembered.
statements.The keyboard stays in the list in every: The keyboard SHALL stay in the list in every home, including beside a terminal.
statements.The working copy is shown as the folders: The working copy SHALL be shown as the folders it changed.
statements.Staging a folder stages everything under: Staging a folder SHALL stage everything under it.
statements.A folder says how much of it is on this: A folder SHALL say how much of it is on this side of the index.
statements.The commit view keeps its place while fi: The commit view SHALL keep its place while files are written.
statements.One question answers which branch the wo: One question SHALL answer which branch the work tree is on.
statements.A branch with no commits on it shows, qu: A branch with no commits on it SHALL show, quietly.
statements.Push says which branch it cannot send: Push SHALL say which branch it cannot send.
statements.The titlebar says which checkout, and op: The titlebar SHALL say which checkout, and SHALL open the others.
statements.Choosing a checkout opens it as a projec: Choosing a checkout SHALL open it as a project.
statements.A list of checkouts is ordered, capped a: A list of checkouts SHALL be ordered, capped and honest.
statements.A checkout is dated by the metadata that: A checkout SHALL be dated by the metadata that moves.
statements.Changes can be thrown away, from the uns: Changes SHALL be able to be thrown away, from the unstaged list only.
statements.Discard says how much it takes, and whic: Discard SHALL say how much it takes, and which of it is deleted.
statements.A discard only restores the paths git tr: A discard SHALL only restore the paths git tracks something under.
